notes: S318 /arc audit. Release safety is the first-order theme: the advertised local Worker deploy bypasses the promotion interlock, the content lane can ship a caller while stranding its Worker callee, and the nominal GitHub Pages rollback origin follows rejected main candidates. Product truth is the second: mobile runtime findings cannot fail CI, The Desk promises daily while stale, and its agent claims stream omits every sourced fact.

items.title: Make every production deploy obey one gate and promote caller plus callee as a capability slice
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED P0. npm run deploy calls scripts/deploy-worker.mjs with only --confirm-production; the script never runs check-production-promotion-gate or the release ceremony, unlike CI. Separately, the content lane explicitly allows changed hash-named client JavaScript while blocking cloudflare/**, the exact architecture that shipped Desk callers and stranded their routes in S317. Outcome: a deploy cannot bypass the hold, and a promoted browser capability cannot arrive before the Worker route it calls.
items.recipe: L2: make the local production Worker path enforce the same promotion gate and fresh release ceremony as CI; extract a caller-to-route capability manifest from promoted shell bundles; block content promotion when a changed caller depends on a route not proven live, and cover the S317 desk-reaction shape with mutation tests.
items.conversionOutcome: A visitor action never lands on a not-yet-deployed endpoint; failed action rate after a content release stays zero.

L1.recipe: Call the promotion interlock and release ceremony inside deploy-worker before Wrangler; necessary flag is never sufficient.

L2.recipe: L1 plus a deterministic client-capability manifest and a content-lane gate that requires route-provenance proof for every changed caller.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a hash-bound CAPABILITY_SLICE receipt pairing Pages bytes, Worker version, route contracts, smoke evidence, and rollback anchors.

executionLog.note: Local and CI Worker production paths now share the fail-closed promotion ceremony. Content promotion extracts literal /v/* callers, hash-binds them, and requires fresh per-route production proof. Self-tests: capability slice 7/7, deploy entrypoint 4/4, promotion gate 14/14, content preflight 5/5.

items.title: Turn 157 recorded mobile defects into a blocking rendered-runtime contract
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED P0. tests/mobile-audit.spec.js records findings but contains no expect(), and check-touch-targets fails only under --strict while build:check calls it without that flag. The durable ledger contains five overflows, 74 small targets, 75 small-font findings, and three image-dimension defects, including reproducible Rank Projector overflow at membership routes. The static mobile contract still passes. Outcome: every touched mobile journey is usable at 360–430px and a runtime regression stops release.
items.recipe: L2: repair Rank Projector containment and the high-severity target/font defects; require zero P0/P1 findings and complete route×viewport execution; run touch-target checking in strict mode; bind the visual receipt to current source SHA, routes, themes, and screenshot hashes.
items.conversionOutcome: Mobile visitors can operate membership controls without horizontal scroll, clipped controls, or sub-44px interaction targets.

L1.recipe: Fix current Rank Projector overflow and enable strict touch-target failure.

L2.recipe: L1 plus executable mobile-audit assertions, route×viewport completeness, and source-bound rendered evidence.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a RUM-weighted responsive sentinel and append-only visual-delta ledger across touched themes and states.

executionLog.note: Rank Projector containment and shared mobile targets repaired. Runtime contract is blocking at 47 routes x 5 viewports; 235/235 passed with zero P0/P1. CANON-053 receipt contains 63/63 manually reviewed captures across three routes, seven themes, and three mobile widths.

items.title: Make rollback restore last-known-good bytes instead of moving main
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED P0. GitHub Pages is configured as a legacy main-branch build and the repository describes it as the warm rollback origin. Direct main pushes continue publishing that origin while Cloudflare promotion can be held, so a DNS rollback can restore the very candidate the release gate rejected. Outcome: rollback points at an immutable verified production artifact and is advanced only after post-deploy smoke.
items.recipe: L2: replace the moving main source with a dedicated rollback publication workflow that deploys an immutable verified SHA/artifact; retain current and previous generations; bind the pointer and recovery instructions to the release receipt.
items.conversionOutcome: A production rollback restores a previously verified site, not an unpromoted candidate.

L1.recipe: Stop legacy main publication and publish a dedicated rollback branch/artifact from the current verified production SHA.

L2.recipe: L1 plus two retained generations, release-receipt binding, and a post-deploy pointer advance.

L3.recipe: L2 plus an automated DNS recovery drill proving Pages bytes, Worker version, CSP, and core routes match the selected receipt.

executionLog.note: Verified live: GitHub Pages is legacy main/. A prior binding decision (D-S303) classifies changing the public warm-rollback origin as founder-scoped. S318 deploy authorization does not silently override that architecture decision; no external Pages setting was mutated. Exact next action: founder explicitly authorizes switching Pages to an immutable rollback branch/artifact, then run the L2 migration and recovery drill.

items.title: Stop unauthenticated push subscription poisoning and unbounded fan-out
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED. The Worker accepts any endpoint up to 512 characters and arbitrary keys, with no origin check or enrollment quota, stores rows for 90 days, and the sender enumerates every row. A bot can create unbounded KV state and force later notification work toward attacker-chosen endpoints. Outcome: only valid same-origin Web Push subscriptions enter a bounded active set.
items.recipe: L2: require HTTPS and allowlisted Web Push hosts, exact p256dh/auth key shapes, same-origin Origin, per-IP/day and global enrollment caps, dedupe, malformed-row quarantine, and hostile-input Worker tests.
items.conversionOutcome: Legitimate notification opt-in continues to work while malformed or abusive enrollments cannot inflate storage or fan-out.

L1.recipe: Validate endpoint scheme/host, key encoding/size, same-origin Origin, and add hostile-input tests.

L2.recipe: L1 plus bounded quotas, dedupe, quarantine/cleanup, and honest enrollment counters.

L3.recipe: L2 plus proof-of-possession enrollment that promotes a quarantined row only after one successful challenge receipt.

executionLog.note: Push enrollment now requires same-origin HTTPS, vendor allowlisting, exact key shapes, bounded bodies, per-IP/global quotas, dedupe, corrupt-row quarantine, and bounded validated dispatch. Worker unit suite passed 48/48.

items.title: Let ChatGPT search reach the AI corpus while retaining the training opt-out
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED. robots.txt blocks GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, and OAI-SearchBot even though the site publishes agents.json, llms.txt, and agent-readable pages for discovery. The validator parses only User-agent: * and cannot see the contradiction. Official OpenAI publisher guidance distinguishes OAI-SearchBot discovery from GPTBot training. Outcome: the public corpus can be surfaced and cited in ChatGPT search without opting the proprietary site into training.
items.recipe: L2: keep GPTBot disallowed; allow OAI-SearchBot and user-request retrieval on public discovery surfaces; parse every named robots group; classify training/search/user agents; verify live routes and document the proprietary citation policy in agents.json.
items.conversionOutcome: A ChatGPT search can discover and cite the public Studio corpus instead of seeing only a title or nothing.

L1.recipe: Allow OAI-SearchBot while preserving GPTBot Disallow.

L2.recipe: L1 plus named-group validation, live UA probes, and an explicit public citation/training policy in agents.json.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a signed agent-access policy with purpose, surface, license, citation, and health fields per agent class.

executionLog.note: Crawler policy now distinguishes training opt-out from public search/user retrieval; all named groups are checked. Crawler self-test 8/8 and local live-coherence check passed.

items.title: Make The Desk daily in evidence—or stop claiming it is
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED. The public JSON-LD and generated hub say Daily AI news while the newest edition and stats are dated 2026-08-11; on 2026-08-16 the public stats feed already classifies both story and fact metrics stale. news:check proves byte coherence, not editorial liveness. Outcome: visitors see a truthful cadence and the editorial pipeline produces a review-held recovery packet instead of silently aging.
items.recipe: L2: derive a freshness state from the latest edition; render Daily only inside its evidence window and periodic/paused when overdue; add a blocking freshness contract for public claims; use the existing trend radar plus zero-model drafter to create a review-held overdue edition packet, never auto-published commentary.
items.conversionOutcome: A visitor can immediately tell whether The Desk is current and can trust the Dispatch cadence claim.

L1.recipe: Add a freshness badge and downgrade Daily to periodic whenever the source is overdue.

L2.recipe: L1 plus a freshness gate and review-held recovery packet built from existing zero-runtime-cost tools.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a format/beat/source/near-term-call flight director with a hash-bound liveness receipt.

executionLog.note: Desk cadence is evidence-derived: overdue editions render periodic rather than daily, publish a freshness receipt, and generate a review-held recovery packet. Freshness self-test 5/5; all 10 generated News pages current.

items.title: Put every sourced fact into the agent claims stream it already promises
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED. Public stats count 21 sourced facts, but api/news-desk-claims.ndjson contains only stance and prediction rows. The producer describes one line per claim and the hub advertises the file as the agent-readable claims stream, yet it never iterates story.facts. Outcome: a human or agent can verify and cite an exact factual claim in one hop.
items.recipe: L2: emit type:fact rows with stable IDs/hashes, exact article anchors, fact text, source URL, story/date, and source-health metadata; render copyable claim receipts; enforce exact page-fact to feed-fact parity and reject orphan/duplicate factRefs.
items.conversionOutcome: An agent can answer which source supports a Desk fact without scraping prose or conflating a persona stance with evidence.

L1.recipe: Emit stable type:fact rows with story, anchor, text, and source URL.

L2.recipe: L1 plus copyable claim receipts, source health, stable hashes, and exact page/feed parity gates.

L3.recipe: L2 plus an append-only claim-change/correction graph with observed and rechecked timestamps.

executionLog.note: Claims feed now emits 21 stable sourced fact rows in a 37-row NDJSON ledger with article anchors and receipts. Claim parity self-test 3/3 and exact live parity passed.

items.title: Make unknown or stale evidence poison green across every public status projection
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED. PROJECT_STATUS simultaneously carries stale 295/295 fingerprints, a legacy testsPassed 302 alias, silScore 981 plus legacy sil 993, currentFocus S317, and lastSessionSummary S316. The last-summary checker is not in the build chain. The CI beacon also records unknown scheduled workflows while allGreen/no-dead-cron can remain true. Outcome: one receipt-bound projection owns each claim, and unknown/stale evidence can never render green.
items.recipe: L2: schema-ban canonical-name lookalikes and stale aliases; project tests/SIL/session summary from authoritative receipts; wire last-session coherence; make scheduled unknown/stale a non-green state with coverage counts and age; include field-data observed-through dates so a fresh generatedAt cannot launder July evidence as August.
items.conversionOutcome: A visitor or agent reading /status receives one internally coherent answer and can see exactly when its evidence was observed.

L1.recipe: Reconcile current status fields, remove or reject legacy aliases, and wire the last-session checker.

L2.recipe: L1 plus unknown-schedule poisoning, coverage/age fields, and observed-through field-vitals semantics.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a typed projection graph where every public claim carries receipt id, release SHA, confidence, and freshness contract.

executionLog.note: Status projection now removes legacy aliases, binds tests/SIL/session fields to authoritative receipts, and makes unknown scheduled CI non-green. Full build passed 309/309; focused status projection and CI beacon tests passed.
